title: Competitive Dashboard Help Content
body:
Competitive Dashboard in the Network360 Analytics Suite gives you an overview of your competitive position with reports like Top Networks, Top Network Market Penetration, and Top Hospitals by Bed Count. ### Accessing Competitive Dashboard There are several ways to access Competitive Dashboard: 1. On the left-hand sidebar navigation panel, click on **Competitive Analysis** or **Sales Tools** and select **Competitive Dashboard** from the menu. 2. On the home page (landing page), click on the graphs in the **Market Penetration: Unique Providers** section. Any of the graphs for **My Networks > Competitor Networks** will bring you to the results of a **Competitive Dashboard** analysis using predetermined search criteria. To run an analysis with other criteria, click the link to **edit criteria**. After entering your criteria, click **Go** to see the results. ## Available Criteria The criteria fields on the Competitive Dashboard form are **Geography**, **Networks**, **Counts**, **Show**, **Sort by**, **Group by** geographic grouping, **Exclude** networks with less than a specified Market Penetration. Please note that the Show criteria field will appear only in projects with confirmed practicing information. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/competitivedashboard1.png) ### Geography You can optionally enter any combination of geographies, including cities, counties, MSAs, CMS rating areas, state abbreviations, the name of a population file, or zip codes (3-digit or 5-digit). The system does not permit searching on other partial zip codes or free form text. When you enter multiple geographies, the search uses ‘or’ logic, therefore, if you enter 'Johnson County, KS' and 'Topeka, KS MSA' you will see providers that are in either geography. If you leave this field blank, you will see results for the project’s entire geography. #### Population File The option to create a Population File is available within the Geography dropdown list. The format of the uploaded file can be: .csv, .txt, .dat, or .xlsx. For more details on creating and using Population Files, please refer to the [Population File](/#!/help/sections/using-network360/sections/population-file) help content. #### Bulk Search By clicking on the Clipboard icon, you can paste a list of up to 200 zip codes. For more details on using Bulk search, please refer to the [Bulk Search](/#!/help/sections/using-network360/sections/bulk-search) help content. #### Radius Search A radius search means that you can search for providers within the specified radius from the centroid of one or more zip codes. Click the Radius Search icon and enter a radius in miles and the zip code(s). For more details on using Radius search, please refer to the [Radius Search](/#!/help/sections/using-network360/sections/radius-search) help content. **NOTE:** The Radius dropdown list also contains an option to create a Population File. ### Networks The list of available networks in the Networks dropdown is filtered by your selected geography. If you don’t select any geographic criteria, then all networks associated with your project will be listed. When you select multiple networks, the search returns the counts for each network, all selected networks together, and the market total. If you select the Select All My Networks, each individual network in My Networks will be listed in the Networks search criteria field. Whereas, if you select All my networks from the Shortcuts section, it will display All my networks in the Networks search criteria field. ### Counts This criteria field determines your desired counting method. You can choose to use either provider, provider location, office, or all counting methods. * Providers: Shows each provider once, regardless of the number of locations at which they practice. For example: Dr. Smith practices at two offices, one on Main St. and a second one on Hill St. The provider count is 1 for this situation. * Provider Locations: Shows each provider, at each practice location. Therefore, when a location has multiple providers practicing at that location, each provider is counted once at that location. For example, if Dr. Smith practices at two offices (on Main St. and on Hill St.) and a second provider, Dr. Jones, practices at two offices: the same location on Main St. and another at Valley Rd., then the Provider Location count will be 4. * Office: Shows each location once, regardless of the number of providers at each location. For example, the office count will be 3 when Dr. Smith practices at Main St. and Hill St and Dr. Jones practices at Main St. and Valley Rd. * All counts means that you see the results for all three counting methods. ### Show These options will determine whether the results will contain all records that match the criteria (Directory) or records which match the criteria and are confirmed practicing (Confirmed Practicing) or both these categories (shown side-by-side). ### Sort In the Sort by field, choose the order in which you want your results. Sort results by Alphanumeric, My networks first, or Network size. ### Group by This Group By feature will determine how the counts are grouped when export reports are generated in CSV. For example, if you Group By county, then, the export reports in csv contain Network Count by Provider Type and the count will be rolled up to the county level. Similarly, if you select Group By, then it will roll up to the state level. ### Exclude You can choose to Exclude the networks with less than 0%-25% market penetration to remove outlying networks from the analysis. ## Results The Competitive Dashboard Results page is comprised of several unique views of your competitive position: Top Networks, Top Network Market Penetration, and Top Hospitals by Bed Count (for a medical project). ### Changing Your Selected Criteria To change your criteria after you see the summary results, click the **Edit Criteria** link to re-open the criteria selection page. #### Top Networks Section This section displays up to the top five networks, based on the count type for the networks and sort order selected in the criteria. * To see more information, you can use your mouse to hover over the bar and a popup will appear. * To quickly see a list of providers represented by bars in the Top Networks chart, click the bar. Notice that the criteria on these results will match the criteria for the bar in the chart. The resulting list represents the providers who make up the count. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/competitivedashboard2.png) #### Top Networks Details Clicking **View Details** in the **Top Networks** section brings you to a graph of the results by core provider type as defined by your selected mapping. In most medical projects, you’ll see results for all core providers, hospital, primary care, and specialist. For most dental projects, you’ll see the results for all core providers, general dentist, and specialist. In most vision projects, you’ll see the results for all core providers, provider, and other facility. Clicking on these category title brings you to a results graph for that category. To see more information for each bar, you can use your mouse to hover on required bar and a popup will appear. To see the detailed list for the results, click within the bar on the chart. Then you will see a list of the results with the selected criteria that matches your selection within the Top Networks Details graph. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/competitivedashboard4.png) #### Market Penetration Section This section displays up to the top five networks, based on the hospital and individual provider counts of the networks. * Click and drag the chart to zoom in to a specific area. * To see more information, you can use your mouse to hover over the dots on the graph and a popup will appear. * If you would like to view details and all the networks in the criteria, click on **View details**. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/competitivedashboard5.png) #### Market Penetration Details If you select **View Details** on the **Market Penetration** Section, the Market Penetration page will display, which is a view of the market penetration chart as well as a table of each network's counts and percent of market penetration. If you selected to show directory, confirmed, or side by side results, then these results reflect your selection. To see more information, you can use your mouse to hover over the dots on the graph and a popup will appear. Each network is plotted on the chart at the intersection provider categories. Networks furthest to the right and furthest to the top have the highest overall market penetration. * In most medical projects, the dots are plotted at the intersection of **Individual Provider count** and **Hospital count**. * In most dental projects, the dots are plotted at the intersection of **General Dentist** and **Specialist counts**. * In most vision projects, the dots are plotted by **Provider counts**. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/competitivedashboard6.png) #### Top Hospitals by Bed Count Top Hospitals by **Bed Count** shows up to the top ten hospitals in the entire geographic area of the analysis. * Click on **View details** to see **Tops Hospitals** grouped by the grouping defined in the criteria. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/competitivedashboard7.png)
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/competitivedashboard8.png) ### Exports You can choose to export a .pdf or .csv report. Clicking the **Export** button will produce the .pdf export. To select the .csv export, click on the down arrow to the right of the export button. Then, you can select the information that you want to be included in your report. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/competitivedashboard9.png) #### PDF Exports The **PDF export** includes all charts from the Competitive Dashboard results, except for the Top Hospitals table, which can be exported to a CSV. #### CSV Exports Contents for the .csv formatted exports, **Network Counts by Provider Type** and **Network Counts by Specialty Group**, will be modified based on the Show selection. * If Show Directory is selected, exports will include all counts. * Confirmed columns are not included in Directory exports. * Column names (showing the Networks selected) * If Show Confirmed is selected, exports will include only Confirmed counts. * Directory columns are not included in Confirmed exports. * Column names (showing the Networks selected) * If Show Side-by-side is selected, exports will include both Directory and Confirmed counts. * Columns names (showing the Networks selected) #### Network Counts by Provider Type Export The Network Counts by Provider Type .csv export includes columns as determined by your criteria selection. For example, location is based on your **Group By** selection. Please note that this report organizes the results by each provider type and includes the total for all provider types. #### Network Counts by Specialty Group Export The Network Counts by Specialty Group .csv export includes columns as determined by your criteria selection. For example, location is based on your **Group By** selection. Please note that this report organizes the results by each specialty groups and includes the total for all specialty groups. #### Top Hospitals by Bed Count Export The Top Hospitals by **Bed Count** .csv export includes the following: * Location is based on your **Group by** selection in the criteria. * Hospital Id * Hospital Name * Total Staffed Bed Count * A column for each network in the analysis criteria, with an indicator of **In** or **Out** of network.
shortDescription: Competitive Dashboard in the Network360 Analytics Suite gives you an overview of your competitive position with reports like Top Networks, Top Network Market Penetration, and Top Hospitals by Bed Count.
